about: Heartside's decision, spend, copy and delete asks for Krish's one list in Control Center (I-24, Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-14). The daily Control Center run proposes each open item behind its wall, in priority order, and reads his answers back by id; a session applies each answer and records it under answer. Posts and their media stay on docs/REVIEW-BOARD.md. Never a customer's details here: this repository is public.

items.title: Hold TikTok rows that say "Link in bio"
items.question: Hold the 02t TikTok rows and phone posts that say "Link in bio" until you approve corrected captions?
items.on_yes: Those rows are held; a session rewrites their captions with a code or counted path (factory/schedule/build_02t.py, the non-Facebook branch) and brings them back for your yes.
items.on_no: They go out as approved, uncounted: TikTok has no clickable link.

items.on_no: On TikTok the buy rows stay without a counted path.

items.on_yes: The engine proposes the restart the day the rule is met, one named creator at a time (rule 7).
items.on_no: Creators stay off until you say.

items.on_no: Reading stays in sessions you start.

items.on_yes: The cap stays at 5; every step up is its own ask (T6).

items.title: The AI label
items.question: Settle the AI label with TikTok's and Meta's policy text read live and cited, before any photorealistic AI format goes above today's volume?
items.on_yes: A session reads both policies, cites them, and reconciles docs/PUBLISHING.md with the floor's no-ai-label.
items.on_no: Photorealistic AI formats stay at today's volume.

answer.where: Settled by his ruling, "No label, settings included" (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-15), without the policy read: AGENTS.md rule 4 and factory/floor.json no-ai-label hold no AI label on any Heartside post, on screen, in captions or in a platform's own AI setting, for AI people and AI dogs alike. A label a platform adds by itself is left as it is.
